ideas.truth: On Diwali, even a shopper's own bag becomes a display piece for the one night the house is dressed to be looked at.
ideas.moment: A hand is about to lift the bag off the table right after the puja thali is cleared, mid-gesture.
ideas.key_frame: A hand mid-reach toward the bag, diyas and marigolds around it, warm light catching both hand and bag.

ideas.truth: The quiet ritual of dressing a home before anyone arrives — everything set exactly in its place, including the good bag, before the first guest walks in.
ideas.moment: The table is fully laid for the evening — diyas lit, marigolds strung — and the bag sits centred as if it always belonged there.
ideas.key_frame: The bag as still-life centrepiece on a richly dressed Diwali table, no people, soft diya bokeh behind it.

ideas.truth: In most homes the 'good' bag lives in a cupboard all year and only earns a place on the table on the biggest night of the year.
ideas.moment: The bag is set down on the table just as the first diya beside it is lit, its surface catching that first flame.
ideas.key_frame: Close on the bag with one diya's flame reflected warmly on its surface, marigolds framing the edge.

why: Using all three moments in sequence (reach → place-and-light → settle) gives the film real before/after tension and a product-hero action, instead of skipping straight to a static centrepiece shot. It still keeps the risk low, because at no point is the bag itself touched by effects, warped, or restyled — only handled and set down like any real object would be.
treatment: We open mid-gesture: a hand reaching for the bag right as the puja thali is cleared — the house is behind schedule, guests are close. The hand lifts it and carries it to the table just as the first diya is lit beside it; for a beat, the bag's own surface catches that flame. Then the hand withdraws and the bag settles into stillness as the true centrepiece — diyas steady, marigold framing the edge, everything else out of focus behind it. The bag itself never changes: same shape, same colour, same label, same proportions throughout. Only its surroundings, and its journey onto the table, are new.

scenes.prompt: A hand mid-reach toward the bag on a table where a puja thali has just been cleared — a few petals and a diya still on the table, faint incense haze. Warm, slightly urgent motion: the hand closes around the bag's handle and lifts it in one continuous move. Keep the bag itself — shape, colour, label, proportions — completely unchanged; only the hand and the moment of contact are new. One action only: hand reaches, grips, lifts.

Continuing the same motion, the hand sets the bag down onto a festively dressed table just as a diya beside it is lit — the flame catches and reflects warmly on the bag's surface for a beat. Marigold strands frame the edge of frame. Warm, unified diya-light as the only light source. One action only: bag is placed down, flame ignites and reflects. Do not alter the bag's shape, colour, label, or proportions — only light and reflection change.

The hand has withdrawn; the bag now rests centred on the dressed Diwali table, diyas steady around it, marigold framing, soft contact shadow grounding it on the table. Subtle, continuous motion only: diya flames flicker gently, marigold strands sway very slightly, a slow, minimal push-in on the bag. Background falls into a warm out-of-focus bokeh of more diyas. One action only: hold on the bag with ambient flicker and a slow push-in. Bag itself must remain exactly as photographed — no shape, colour, or label changes.

finish.copy_placement: Single line — "Home, dressed for tonight." — appears only in the final scene, lower third, clear of the bag and diya bokeh so it never competes with the marigold framing.
finish.end_card: No separate end card; the film ends on the held, slow-push-in hero frame from scene 3 — bag centred on the dressed table — so it closes on the product itself.
finish.music: Soft, warm ambient bed with a faint traditional bell/chime accent, no vocals, under 6s total, kept low so it never competes with the vaubab ambient diya-crackle mood; volume falls slightly on scene 3 so the closing line and image land quietly.
